blocks.text: AI sometimes makes up facts, numbers or sources – and sounds completely sure. This is called a "hallucination". The good news: it's easy to learn how to protect yourself.
When AI makes mistakes most often

items: Links and titles of books or studies.
Ask: "How sure are you? What should I double-check here?"
Ask for sources – then open them and check they really exist.
Check important things on an official website or with an expert.
Ask the same question in a different way and compare.

blocks.text: Answer my question, and at the end list separately which parts I should double-check and where. Question: how long is an adult passport valid in the UK?
AI is great for understanding and ideas, but for final decisions about health, money and the law, always ask an expert.
Claude will often say when it isn't sure – watch for those sentences and check exactly those parts.
ChatGPT can search the web and show links to sources – click them and check.
Some versions of Gemini offer a button to double-check the answer with Google Search – use it when it matters.
